notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.45 restores separate teaching diaries and schemes for each class and arm, preserving earlier class-wide records as read-only history. The matching backend repair saves valid CBT scores even when other students are rejected, reports rejected students separately, and keeps retries duplicate-safe. Existing answers, scores, diary approvals and financial records are preserved. Back up and close Dynamax before updating both CBT servers between examinations. Do not uninstall, clear saved data or recreate tests. No new tablet APK is required.
